description: Add Toss-Up and Bonus Round game modes to the iOS Wheel of Fortune practice app

userStories.title: Extend TurnState and GameState types for new modes
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the type system extended to support Toss-Up and Bonus Round flow states before implementing any logic.
acceptanceCriteria: In ios/src/engine/types.ts, extend TurnState union with: 'TOSSUP_REVEALING' | 'TOSSUP_BUZZED' | 'TOSSUP_LOCKED_OUT' | 'BONUS_PICKING' | 'BONUS_SOLVE_TIMER'
Existing TurnState values unchanged: 'IDLE' | 'SPINNING' | 'GUESSING_CONSONANT' | 'BUYING_VOWEL' | 'SOLVING' | 'ROUND_OVER'
Add to GameState: tossUpElapsedMs: number, tossUpRevealIntervalMs: number, tossUpLockoutMs: number, tossUpLockoutDurationMs: number
Add to GameState: bonusTimerMs: number, bonusTimerDurationMs: number, roundResult: 'win' | 'loss' | null
Add optional field to Puzzle interface: allowed_modes?: RoundType[]

Update INITIAL_STATE in game.ts with defaults: tossUpElapsedMs: 0, tossUpRevealIntervalMs: 1000, tossUpLockoutMs: 0, tossUpLockoutDurationMs: 3000, bonusTimerMs: 20000, bonusTimerDurationMs: 20000, roundResult: null
Typecheck passes
All existing 172 tests pass
userStories.notes: TurnState is defined inline in GameState type in types.ts. INITIAL_STATE and GameAction are in game.ts.

userStories.title: Add puzzle mode eligibility metadata

Categories excluded from BONUS mode: 'Before & After', 'Same Name', 'Rhyme Time', 'Song Lyrics', 'Title/Author' (case-insensitive matching)
All other categories get allowed_modes: ['MAIN', 'TOSSUP', 'BONUS']
Excluded categories get allowed_modes: ['MAIN', 'TOSSUP']
Add and export function getPuzzlesForMode(puzzles: Puzzle[], mode: RoundType): Puzzle[] that filters by allowed_modes, falling back to all modes if allowed_modes is undefined

Create ios/src/__tests__/puzzleModes.test.ts with tests: 'Before & After' puzzle excluded from BONUS, 'Phrase' puzzle eligible for all modes, getPuzzlesForMode filters correctly, puzzles without allowed_modes default to eligible for all modes
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Toss-Up engine: START_ROUND and auto-reveal tick
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the reducer to handle Toss-Up round initialization and timed letter reveal.
acceptanceCriteria: In gameReducer START_ROUND case: when puzzle.round_type === 'TOSSUP', set turnState to 'TOSSUP_REVEALING' (not 'IDLE')
Enhance TOSS_UP_TICK action type to accept { type: 'TOSS_UP_TICK'; dtMs: number }

In TOSS_UP_TICK handler: add dtMs to tossUpElapsedMs. When tossUpElapsedMs >= tossUpRevealIntervalMs, reveal next letter from tossUpRevealOrder[tossUpIndex], increment tossUpIndex, reset tossUpElapsedMs to remainder
When turnState is 'TOSSUP_LOCKED_OUT': TOSS_UP_TICK decrements tossUpLockoutMs by dtMs. When tossUpLockoutMs <= 0, set turnState back to 'TOSSUP_REVEALING' and reset tossUpLockoutMs to 0
When all letters in tossUpRevealOrder are revealed (tossUpIndex >= tossUpRevealOrder.length): set turnState to 'ROUND_OVER', roundResult to 'loss', reveal all positions
TOSS_UP_TICK is a no-op when turnState is not 'TOSSUP_REVEALING' and not 'TOSSUP_LOCKED_OUT'

Create ios/src/__tests__/tossUpEngine.test.ts with tests: reveal cadence respects 1000ms interval, partial ticks accumulate, reveal order matches seeded shuffle, round ends as loss when all revealed, tick is no-op when buzzed
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Existing TOSS_UP_TICK action has no dtMs param. The GameAction union is in game.ts. SeededRNG shuffle already produces tossUpRevealOrder in START_ROUND.

userStories.title: Toss-Up engine: buzz-in, solve, and lockout
userStories.description: As a developer, I need buzz-in and lockout mechanics for Toss-Up mode.
acceptanceCriteria: Add new action BUZZ_IN to GameAction union: { type: 'BUZZ_IN' }
BUZZ_IN handler: only works when turnState is 'TOSSUP_REVEALING'. Sets turnState to 'TOSSUP_BUZZED'. Preserves all other state.
Add new action TOSS_UP_SOLVE_ATTEMPT: { type: 'TOSS_UP_SOLVE_ATTEMPT'; phrase: string }

TOSS_UP_SOLVE_ATTEMPT handler: only works when turnState is 'TOSSUP_BUZZED'. Correct solve (case-insensitive match): set turnState to 'ROUND_OVER', roundResult to 'win', reveal all positions. Wrong solve: set turnState to 'TOSSUP_LOCKED_OUT', set tossUpLockoutMs to tossUpLockoutDurationMs (3000)
BUZZ_IN is a no-op when turnState is 'TOSSUP_LOCKED_OUT' or not 'TOSSUP_REVEALING'

Add tests to ios/src/__tests__/tossUpEngine.test.ts: buzz-in pauses reveal (turnState changes to TOSSUP_BUZZED), correct solve ends round as win, wrong solve triggers lockout, lockout expires after 3000ms of ticks and resumes revealing, cannot buzz during lockout
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Build on the tossUpEngine.test.ts created in US-003. TOSS_UP_TICK lockout logic was added in US-003.

userStories.title: Toss-Up end-to-end round simulation test
userStories.description: As a developer, I need full round simulation tests proving Toss-Up works end-to-end.
acceptanceCriteria: Add simulation test to ios/src/__tests__/tossUpEngine.test.ts: start round with known seed -> tick several reveals -> buzz in -> wrong solve -> lockout -> tick through lockout -> resume -> buzz in -> correct solve -> round over with roundResult 'win'
Add simulation test: start round -> tick all letters revealed -> round ends with roundResult 'loss'
Both tests use a fixed seed for deterministic reveal order
Both tests verify intermediate state at each step (turnState, revealedPositions count, tossUpIndex, roundResult)
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: These are integration-style tests exercising the full reducer flow. Use a simple puzzle like 'HELLO WORLD' with a known seed.

userStories.title: Bonus Round engine: START_ROUND and letter picking
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the reducer to handle Bonus Round initialization and the 3-consonant + 1-vowel letter picking phase.
acceptanceCriteria: In gameReducer START_ROUND case: when puzzle.round_type === 'BONUS', set turnState to 'BONUS_PICKING' (not 'IDLE'). Reset bonusTimerMs to bonusTimerDurationMs. Set roundResult to null.
Add new action BONUS_CHOOSE_LETTERS: { type: 'BONUS_CHOOSE_LETTERS'; consonants: [string, string, string]; vowel: string }

BONUS_CHOOSE_LETTERS handler: only works when turnState is 'BONUS_PICKING'. Validates: exactly 3 distinct consonants (in CONSONANTS list), exactly 1 vowel (in VOWELS list), no letter is in ['R','S','T','L','N','E']. On invalid: return state unchanged.
On valid: add all 4 letters to guessedLetters, reveal all positions where those letters appear in the phrase, set bonusPicks to the 4 chosen letters, transition to turnState 'BONUS_SOLVE_TIMER'

Create ios/src/__tests__/bonusEngine.test.ts with tests: START_ROUND reveals RSTLNE and sets BONUS_PICKING, valid letter picks reveal correct positions and transition to BONUS_SOLVE_TIMER, RSTLNE letters are rejected, duplicate consonants rejected, invalid letters rejected
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: VOWELS and CONSONANTS constants are in types.ts. START_ROUND already has BONUS logic for RSTLNE reveal — extend it, don't replace.

userStories.title: Bonus Round engine: timed solve and expiry
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the Bonus Round solve timer countdown and solve attempt logic.
acceptanceCriteria: Add new action BONUS_TICK: { type: 'BONUS_TICK'; dtMs: number }

BONUS_TICK handler: only works when turnState is 'BONUS_SOLVE_TIMER'. Decrements bonusTimerMs by dtMs. When bonusTimerMs <= 0: set turnState to 'ROUND_OVER', roundResult to 'loss', reveal all positions.
Add new action BONUS_SOLVE_ATTEMPT: { type: 'BONUS_SOLVE_ATTEMPT'; phrase: string }

BONUS_SOLVE_ATTEMPT handler: only works when turnState is 'BONUS_SOLVE_TIMER'. Correct solve (case-insensitive match): set turnState to 'ROUND_OVER', roundResult to 'win', reveal all positions. Wrong solve: return state unchanged (player can try again within timer).

Add tests to ios/src/__tests__/bonusEngine.test.ts: timer decrements correctly, solve during timer works (win), wrong solve allows retry (state unchanged), timer expiry ends round as loss, BONUS_TICK is no-op when not in BONUS_SOLVE_TIMER, BONUS_SOLVE_ATTEMPT is no-op when not in BONUS_SOLVE_TIMER
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Build on the bonusEngine.test.ts created in US-006.

Add simulation test: start round -> RSTLNE revealed -> choose letters -> tick timer to expiry (20000ms) -> round over with roundResult 'loss'

userStories.title: Home screen mode selector cards
userStories.description: As a player, I want to choose between Standard, Toss-Up, and Bonus Round from the home screen.
acceptanceCriteria: In StandardModeApp.tsx, add a new state: selectedRoundMode: RoundType (default 'MAIN')

Replace or extend the existing Play card on the home screen with 3 mode cards: 'Standard Game' (description: 'Spin the wheel, guess letters, solve the puzzle'), 'Toss-Up' (description: 'Letters reveal one by one — buzz in to solve!'), 'Bonus Round' (description: 'Pick your letters, solve before time runs out')
Each card uses the existing card styling pattern (LinearGradient, icon, title, description) already in the home screen
Tapping a mode card sets selectedRoundMode and navigates to activeScreen 'game'
When navigating to game, use getPuzzlesForMode() to filter puzzles from activePack based on selectedRoundMode
When starting a new round, pass selectedRoundMode as the puzzle's round_type (override the puzzle's own round_type since all puzzles are tagged MAIN in pack data)
Import getPuzzlesForMode from packs.ts
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Home screen is in StandardModeApp.tsx. Existing card pattern uses LinearGradient + lucide icons (Play, BookOpen, BarChart3). The Play card currently just starts a MAIN round. Icons suggestion: Play for Standard, Zap for Toss-Up, Trophy for Bonus.

userStories.title: Toss-Up UI screen
userStories.description: As a player, I want to play Toss-Up rounds with auto-revealing letters and a Buzz In button.
acceptanceCriteria: In StandardModeApp.tsx, when activeScreen is 'game' and selectedRoundMode is 'TOSSUP': hide the wheel component, hide the standard keyboard, show a 'Buzz In' button centered below the puzzle board
Use setInterval (or requestAnimationFrame) to dispatch TOSS_UP_TICK with dtMs every ~16-33ms (frame rate). The reducer handles accumulating time and revealing letters at the 1000ms interval
When turnState is 'TOSSUP_BUZZED': show the solve modal (reuse existing solve modal pattern with TextInput)
When turnState is 'TOSSUP_LOCKED_OUT': disable Buzz In button, show countdown text like 'Locked out... 2s'
When turnState is 'ROUND_OVER' and roundResult is 'win': show celebration (confetti + Vanna). When roundResult is 'loss': show 'Puzzle Revealed' message
Show 'Next Puzzle' button on round over (reuse existing pattern with celebrationReady delay for wins)
Status banner above board shows 'TOSS-UP' and context text ('Buzz in to solve!', 'Locked out...', etc.)
Wire expo-haptics: Haptics.impactAsync on buzz-in tap, Haptics.notificationAsync(success/error) on solve result
Clear interval on unmount and when round ends
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Existing solve modal uses Modal component with TextInput and keyboardShouldPersistTaps='handled'. Haptics already imported in StandardModeApp. The tick interval should run only when turnState is TOSSUP_REVEALING or TOSSUP_LOCKED_OUT.

userStories.title: Bonus Round UI: letter picking phase
userStories.description: As a player, I want to pick 3 consonants + 1 vowel after RSTLNE is revealed in Bonus Round.
acceptanceCriteria: In StandardModeApp.tsx, when activeScreen is 'game' and selectedRoundMode is 'BONUS' and turnState is 'BONUS_PICKING': hide the wheel, show the Keyboard component with RSTLNE letters disabled/grayed out
Add local UI state for tracking letter picks before confirming: selectedConsonants: string[] (max 3), selectedVowel: string | null

Keyboard onPress handler: if letter is consonant and selectedConsonants.length < 3, add to selectedConsonants. If letter is vowel and selectedVowel is null and selectedConsonants.length === 3, set selectedVowel. Already-selected letters shown as highlighted/selected.
Allow deselecting: tapping a selected letter removes it from the selection
Show 'Confirm' button below keyboard, enabled only when selectedConsonants.length === 3 and selectedVowel is not null
On confirm: dispatch BONUS_CHOOSE_LETTERS with consonants and vowel, clear local selection state
Show pick progress indicator: '3 consonants + 1 vowel' with counts updating as player selects
Status banner shows 'BONUS ROUND' and 'Pick 3 consonants, then 1 vowel'
Wire expo-haptics: light impact on each letter pick
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Keyboard component is at ios/src/components/Keyboard.tsx. It accepts onPress callback and has consonant/vowel sections. RSTLNE = ['R','S','T','L','N','E']. The picking order is enforced: consonants first (3), then vowel (1).

userStories.title: Bonus Round UI: timed solve phase
userStories.description: As a player, I want to solve the Bonus Round puzzle under a 20-second countdown timer.
acceptanceCriteria: When turnState transitions to 'BONUS_SOLVE_TIMER': hide keyboard, show TextInput for solve attempt (always visible, not in modal), start timer interval dispatching BONUS_TICK with dtMs every ~16-33ms
Show large countdown timer display: seconds and tenths (e.g., '15.3') prominently above or below the board
Submit button next to TextInput. On press: dispatch BONUS_SOLVE_ATTEMPT with input text, clear input on wrong guess
On correct solve (roundResult 'win'): stop timer, show celebration (confetti + Vanna), show Next Puzzle after delay
On wrong solve: brief shake animation on TextInput or red flash feedback, input cleared, timer continues
On timer expiry (roundResult 'loss'): stop interval, show 'Time\'s Up!' message, reveal full puzzle, show Next Puzzle
Wire expo-haptics: warning haptic in last 5 seconds (every second), success/error on solve result, strong impact on timer expiry
Clear interval on unmount and when round ends
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Timer runs from 20000ms down to 0. bonusTimerMs in state tracks remaining time. Use Animated shake for wrong guess feedback (Reanimated withSequence + withTiming for translateX oscillation).

userStories.title: Background/foreground timer handling
userStories.description: As a player, I don't want timers to desync when I background the app.
acceptanceCriteria: In StandardModeApp.tsx, add AppState listener (import { AppState } from 'react-native') with useRef to track backgroundTimestamp
On AppState change to 'background' or 'inactive': record Date.now() in backgroundTimestamp ref

On AppState change to 'active': compute elapsed = Date.now() - backgroundTimestamp. If in TOSSUP mode (TOSSUP_REVEALING or TOSSUP_LOCKED_OUT): dispatch TOSS_UP_TICK with dtMs = elapsed to catch up reveals/lockout. If in BONUS mode (BONUS_SOLVE_TIMER): dispatch BONUS_TICK with dtMs = elapsed to catch up timer
The reducer handles large dtMs correctly: TOSS_UP_TICK reveals multiple letters if enough time passed, BONUS_TICK expires if bonusTimerMs would go <= 0
Clean up AppState listener on unmount
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: The TOSS_UP_TICK handler from US-003 should already handle large dtMs by revealing one letter at a time. But verify: if dtMs = 5000 and interval = 1000, it should reveal 5 letters. If the current implementation only reveals one per tick call, the handler needs to loop.

userStories.title: Fix TOSS_UP_TICK to handle large dtMs (multi-reveal)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need TOSS_UP_TICK to handle catching up multiple reveals in a single dispatch for background resume.
acceptanceCriteria: In gameReducer TOSS_UP_TICK handler: when accumulated tossUpElapsedMs exceeds tossUpRevealIntervalMs, reveal multiple letters in a loop (not just one)
Loop: while tossUpElapsedMs >= tossUpRevealIntervalMs AND tossUpIndex < tossUpRevealOrder.length: reveal next letter, increment index, subtract interval from elapsed
If all letters revealed during the loop: break, set roundResult 'loss', turnState 'ROUND_OVER'
Similarly for lockout: if dtMs > tossUpLockoutMs, clear lockout and apply remaining time as reveal ticks
Add test: dispatch TOSS_UP_TICK with dtMs=5000 when interval=1000 -> 5 letters revealed
Add test: dispatch TOSS_UP_TICK with dtMs=50000 on short puzzle -> all letters revealed, round over as loss
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: This ensures background resume works correctly. Place before US-013 logically, but both can be tested independently.

Verify puzzle packs load without errors (ALL_PACKS builds successfully)
Verify StandardModeApp renders home screen with 3 mode cards without crashing
Add regression test in ios/src/__tests__/gameReducer.test.ts: standard MAIN round flow (start -> spin -> guess -> solve) works identically to before
